test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Put this plant __nearby__ a window so that it gets enough light.
solution:
The correct answer is '**next to**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given above sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• In the above-given sentence, 'nearby' will be replaced by ‘next to’.
 
• As per the general rule, '**next to**' is a preposition of place,</strong&
